provenance.author: dnd-diceroll project agents (Claude Opus 5.5) for the repository owner
provenance.license: Project-owned original work; same terms as this repository
provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender 5.2.3 LTS for the Vault finale set piece (#250): the rune seal around the Waystone artifact, in the Vault kit r002 look (blue-black basalt, one cold-blue glow accent); all textures and geometry procedural; no third-party, kit, AI-service or downloaded content

recipe.method: Authored in Blender by script (build_setpiece_vault.py): a faceted basalt chip about 12 cm across with a rune fleck, thrown when the seal shatters; vertex colour = ray-cast self ambient occlusion x height gradient; glow only via COLOR_0.a on the rune material
recipe.approved_reference: The Vault kit r002 (#149, Art/dark-fantasy-sources/r002-vault); #250 scope (Austin, 2026-11-15)

parameters.units: metres at true scale (the Vault is authored at the 150 cm cell and placed unscaled)
parameters.sampling: Linear, 8 px wrapped padding per atlas region
parameters.use: finale only: six shards float around the artifact in the apse and fly onto the dais along pre-authored arcs when the finale is won (no physics)

settings.importer: Interchange glTF via Content/Python/import_dark_fantasy_theme.py (theme_plan.SETPIECE_R001; new packages only, nothing replaced, no data-asset entry)
settings.material: MI_* child of M_DiceRollTheme: texture x COLOR_0.rgb, glow from COLOR_0.a
settings.texture_filter: trilinear with anisotropic 8, mips generated, never nearest
settings.texture_compression: default (sRGB, mips); no nearest or editor-icon compression
settings.collision: none (presentation only; the set piece never blocks anything)
settings.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 VEC4 normalised uint16 (RGB light, A glow mask)
settings.axes: metres, +X forward, Z up (glTF Y-up export)
